Building the Open Source Culture in Trichy

FOSS Club at SRM Institute of Science & Technology, Trichy is a student-driven open-source community focused on collaboration, innovation, and real-world development through technology and community-driven learning.

What is FOSS ?

Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) represents a culture of collaboration, transparency, and innovation where technology is built collectively and shared openly. Our club aims to introduce students to the power of open-source development by creating opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow through real-world technical experiences.

Why FOSS matters ?

Free and Open Source Software (FOSS) represents a culture of collaboration, transparency, and innovation where technology is built collectively and shared openly. Our club aims to introduce students to the power of open-source development by creating opportunities to learn, contribute, and grow through real-world technical experiences.

Vision -

To establish a strong and sustainable open-source ecosystem in Trichy by empowering students with real-world technical exposure and collaborative development practices.

Mision -

Promote open-source awareness and contribution culture
Encourage collaborative learning and innovation
Create opportunities for practical technical growth
Connect students with real-world developer communities
